text:
We've got a bright, chilly late morning, with temperatures only in the low 40s and a breeze that makes it feel colder. Clouds should fill in through the afternoon, so the sun won't last. Any sprinkles up in those clouds should dry out before they reach the ground, so no umbrella needed. We still climb to around 53, with a light south wind. A jacket will do for the afternoon, and it gets dark around quarter to 6.

Tonight stays mostly clear and mild for late October, with a low around 43. The south wind picks up a bit overnight.

Thursday is the surprise. Sunshine and a gusty south wind push us to about 66, and it could get close to 70. Gusts near 28 mph will be noticeable on a walk or bike ride. A cold front brings a few showers after 8pm Thursday into the early morning, but I'd expect less than a tenth of an inch. The European model is wetter, but I'd bet on mostly dry. Friday turns breezy and cooler.
